# TradingView — How to import trades from TradingView into TradeZella?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/6992227-tradingview-how-to-import-trades-from-tradingview-into-tradezella

To import your trade data from TradingView into TradeZella, you'll export a CSV file from TradingView and upload it to TradeZella. Here's how to do it.



## Export Your Trade History from TradingView

Step 1: Log in to your TradingView account and open any chart.



Step 2: At the bottom of the screen, click on Paper Trading (or Live Trading if you're using a live account).



Step 3: Click on the Order History tab.



Step 4: Click the Column setup icon in the top-right corner of the Order History table.



Check all the boxes: Side, Type, Quantity, Limit price, Stop price, Fill price, Status, Commission, Placing time, Closing time, Order ID, Level ID, Leverage, and Margin.





Step 5: Click the Download data icon (top-right corner of the table). In the dialog that appears, select Order history from the dropdown, then click Download.





A CSV file will automatically be downloaded.



## Uploading the exported file to TradeZella

Now that your file has been exported into a CSV let's upload it to TradeZella!

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select TradingView as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select TradingView as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

- If you’re using TradingView paper trading, select “Other” as the broker Company.

If you’re using TradingView paper trading, select “Other” as the broker Company.



## Common Errors

- Select All Columns: If your file fails to upload, it may be due to incorrect headers. Ensure that when exporting your trade data into a file, you select all the columns.
